statement.p: Find the vertices, foci, axes, center (if an ellipse or a hyperbola) and asymptotes (if a hyperbola) of the conic section x^2+6 y^2 = 36

The conic section is
An ellipse
A Parabola
A hyperbola

The focal axis and the conjugate axis are
y=0 and x=0 respectively.
x=36 and y=6 respectively.
x=0 and y=0 respectively.
y=6 and x=36 respectively.

The conic section's center is at
(0,0)
(-6,-6)
(6,36)
(6,6)
(1,1)

static.solution:
36 to convert it to the equation in standard form: \frac{{x}^{2}}{36}+\frac{6 {y}^{2}}{36}=1 \Rightarrow \frac{{x}^{2}}{36}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{6}=1 \Rightarrow {\left(\frac{x}{6}\right)}^{2}+{\left(\frac{y}{\sqrt{6}}\right)}^{2}=1 For this ellipse, a=6 and b=\sqrt{6} hence c=\sqrt{{6}^{2}-\left(\sqrt{6}\right)^2}=\sqrt{30}.
Since a>b we have:
\bullet The vertices are at \left(\pm 6, 0\right),\left(0, \pm \sqrt{6}\right).
\bullet The foci are {F}_{1}=\left(-\sqrt{30}, 0\right) and {F}_{2}=\left(\sqrt{30}, 0\right).
\bullet The focal axis is the x-axis and the conjugate axis is the y-axis.
\bullet The ellipse is centered at the origin.
